topic: What if your pet swallowed your mom? (blocky-game What If, long-form 16:9, about 6 minutes)
title: PET SWALLOWED
MOM

script.text: What if your pet swallowed your mom?
Not a little nibble. The whole mom. In one gulp.
And the only way to get her back, is to go inside.
Okay. This is the worst day of my life.
This is Biscuit. He's a good boy. He's also always hungry.
And today, Biscuit is extra hungry.
Chapter one. The snack.
It starts like any normal Saturday. Mom is cleaning the living room.
Biscuit, do not touch my slippers.
Biscuit eats the slippers.
Biscuit!
Then the pizza from last night. Then the remote. Then, the whole vacuum cleaner.
You've never seen a dog chew that fast.
Biscuit! Spit that out right now!
Mom walks over to grab the vacuum.
Biscuit opens his mouth. Wider. Wider. Way too wide.
Gulp.
And just like that, Mom is gone.
Mom? Mom! Biscuit, what did you do?
Biscuit burps. A slipper flies out. Mom does not.
You can hear her though. Very faintly. Very angry.
Get me out of here!
You need a plan. And you know exactly where to find one.
Mom always said video games would never help you in real life. Mom was about to be very wrong.
You open Block Quest, and go straight to the shop.
Shrink potion. Ninety-nine gems. Warning: do not drink near pets.
You drink it. Near the pet.
Everything gets huge. The couch is a mountain. The carpet is a jungle. And Biscuit's mouth is a cave.
Okay, Biscuit. Say ahh.
Biscuit yawns. And you run straight in.
Chapter two. The mouth.
Inside, it's dark, it's wet, and it smells like old pizza.
The teeth are like giant white blocks. And they're moving.
One wrong step, and you're dog food. Literally.
Chomp. Chomp. Chomp. You time your jumps perfectly. One, two, three.
Then the tongue moves. It's a giant pink slide. And you're on it.
Whoaaa!
You slide down at full speed, past a dog treat, a sock, and somehow, a whole crayon.
But then, a wave of slobber comes rolling in.
You grab the crayon and use it as a surfboard.
You surf the slobber wave all the way down the throat.
Okay, this is actually kind of awesome!
Speedrunner? No. Slobber runner.
Chapter three. The stomach.
You land in a giant green room, with a lake of bubbling stomach juice.
Don't touch it. It's basically lava, but grosser.
Floating everywhere is everything Biscuit ever ate. Slippers, pizza, the remote, and a tennis ball from twenty nineteen.
And there, floating on the vacuum cleaner like a boat, is Mom.
Finally! Do you know how long I've been in here?
Like, five minutes?
Five minutes too long!
You jump from slipper, to pizza, to remote, and you make it to the vacuum.
But something in the juice starts to bubble. Something big.
A giant ball of fur rises out of the lake. It has eyes. It has a crown.
Is that a crown?
Don't make eye contact.
It's the Hairball King. Made from every hair Biscuit ever licked off the couch.
Boss fight.
Its health bar is huge. Your only weapon is a slipper.
The Hairball King throws furballs. You dodge one. Two. The third one hits Mom.
That's it. Give me that.
Mom turns on the vacuum cleaner.
The Hairball King gets sucked in. Hair by hair. Until there's nothing left but the crown.
Never mess with a mom who's holding a vacuum.
Chapter four. The escape.
Now you just have to get out. Simple, right?
Wrong. The shrink potion is wearing off. You're starting to grow.
And if you grow inside Biscuit, things are going to get very, very weird.
And Biscuit is waking up from his nap. Every step he takes shakes the whole stomach like a rollercoaster.
You have thirty seconds.
Mom has an idea.
Dogs sneeze when something tickles their nose. We need to tickle him from the inside.
You use the Hairball King's crown to tickle the stomach wall.
Nothing. You tickle harder.
The whole stomach starts to shake. Biscuit is going to hiccup.
Hic! You get launched halfway up the throat.
Hic! You get launched up to the mouth.
Ten seconds left. You're both growing. The teeth are getting smaller.
Then Biscuit does the biggest sneeze in dog history.
Achoo!
Chapter five. Home.
You fly out of Biscuit's nose and land on the couch, with Mom right next to you.
You grow back to normal size. Mom grows back to normal size. The vacuum grows back too.
The living room is a total mess. Slobber everywhere. Pizza on the ceiling. And Biscuit somehow gets a treat.
Biscuit just sits there. Wagging his tail. Like nothing happened.
You, young man, are grounded.
For saving you?
For buying a shrink potion with my credit card.
Fair.
That night, Dad comes home from work.
He walks into the living room, holding a big, juicy sandwich.
Biscuit looks at the sandwich. Then he looks at Dad. Then he licks his lips.
Dad. Run.
So, would you go inside your pet to save your mom? Comment Biscuit if you would.
And subscribe, so Biscuit doesn't eat you next.
